messages:
Maddie: FYI opened a small PR to tweak the SOC2 retention wording and update SDK snippets for export examples. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :link: 
Ken: saw it — thanks. quick read: you renamed `retention_days` -> `retention_ttl_days` in the Python example, is that intentional? could break old snippet consumers.
Maddie: yep intentional, we added a migration note but wanted to discuss the phrasing. current PR adds a short upgrade section and preserves the old param for backward compat for one release.
Julian: can we instead keep the old name in examples but call out the preferred new key? many users copy-paste examples.
Ken: +1 to Julian. also the Node snippet uses `ttl` while python uses `retention_ttl_days` — we should align.
Maddie: fair. updated in branch to use `retention_ttl_days` everywhere and added a one-liner at top: "When upgrading, `retention_days` is deprecated; use `retention_ttl_days`. Both accepted until vX.Y."
Susan (Legal): quick read — please avoid phrasing like "we delete after X" without noting legal holds. For SOC2 docs we say "data is retained for up to X days unless subject to legal hold or export requests." Also prefer "retention period" over "TTL" in customer-facing language.
Ken: good catch. we can keep TTL key in SDK examples but the human copy should say "retention period". so code uses `retention_ttl_days` but text clarifies the term.
Maddie: updated text now to: "Default retention period: 30 days. Use `retention_ttl_days` in SDK calls to override. Legal holds will prevent deletion." PTAL @Susan (Legal)
Susan (Legal): that reads better. also add a one-line about exports: "Exports include only events within the retention period unless otherwise requested via support/legal."
Julian: small nit — the Python snippet currently shows: ```py
client.export_audit_logs(retention_days=30)
``` change to: ```py
client.export_audit_logs(retention_ttl_days=30)
``` and add a comment above explaining deprecation.
Maddie: done in branch. I also added a migration checkbox in the PR description and a link to the SDK changelog entry.
docs-bot: PR opened by Maddie: #4821 — "retention wording + snippets: align TTL naming, add migration note" (labels: docs, soc2, sdk-snippet)
Ken: one last thing — we reference an internal API path `/v1/audit/export` in the examples. public docs should use the SDK wrappers, not raw endpoints. can we switch the raw curl example to the CLI SDK call?
Maddie: good point. replaced curl with `rictl audit export --retention 30` example and left a tiny raw HTTP example in an advanced appendix.
Susan (Legal): approved for wording changes as long as the export line about legal holds is present. :white_check_mark:
Julian: LGTM for snippet alignment. I left a tiny comment about formatting in the Ruby sample.
Maddie: thanks all — merging after docs CI passes. I'll follow up with a short release note for the SDK teams to bump minor versions and keep the compatibility shim for one release. Any objections to the timeline (merge today, ship changelog tomorrow)?
Ken: sounds fine. I'll coordinate with SDK owners to cut compatibility patch if needed.
Maddie: perfect, closing thread once merged. :tada:
